examples.text: sūlaṃ karitvā ye mahāsamudde mahantakā pāṇā te mahantakesu sūlesu āvuneyya, ye mahāsamudde majjhimakā pāṇā te majjhimakesu sūlesu āvuneyya, ye mahāsamudde sukhumakā pāṇā te sukhumakesu sūlesu āvuneyya.
mahā vat'āyaṃ, bhante, papāto subhayānako, bhante, papāto. atthi nu kho, bhante, imamhā papātā añño papāto mahantataro ca bhayānakataro cā'ti?
appamatto ayaṃ kali, yo akkhesu dhanaparājayo, sabbassā'pi sahā'pi attanā, ayam'eva mahantataro kali.

evam'eva paṇḍito thokam'pi pābhataṃ labhitvā nānāupāyehi payojetvā dhanañ'ca yasañ'ca vaḍḍheti, vaḍḍhetvā ca pana tattha attānaṃ patiṭṭhāpeti, tāya eva vā pana dhanayasamahantatāya attānaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti, abhiññātaṃ pākaṭaṃ karotī'ti attho.

51604.commentary: (MNa) yadidaṃ mahantattenā'ti mahantabhāvena aggaṃ akkhāyati, na guṇavasenā'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, yadidaṃ mahantattena
evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya satta bojjh'aṅge bhāvento satta bojjh'aṅge bahulīkaronto mahantattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesū'ti.

51607.construction:
maha + nta + tara
mahanta + tara > mahantara

examples.text: appamattako ayaṃ kali, yo akkhesu dhanaparājayo, sabbassā'pi sahā'pi attanā, ayam'eva mahantaro kali, yo sugatesu manaṃ padosaye.

51608.grammar: adj, fem nom sg of mahanta
51608.meaning1: great; large; powerful; grand; mighty; vast; extensive

examples.text: mahanto ca so puriso cā'ti mahāpuriso, mahantī ca sā devī cā'ti mahādevī, mahantañ'ca taṃ balañ'cā'ti mahābalaṃ, mahanto ca so nāgo cā'ti mahānāgo, mahanto ca so yaso cā'ti mahāyaso

51609.meaning1: of great fruit; yielding good results
51609.commentary: (MNa) mahapphalā mah'ānisaṃsā'ti ubhayam'etaṃ atthato ekaṃ, byañjanam'eva nānaṃ. mahantaṃ vā lokiyasukhaṃ phalantīti mahapphalā. mahato lok'uttarasukhassa ca paccayā hontī'ti mah'ānisaṃsā.

examples.text: tiṇadosāni khettāni, rāgadosā ayaṃ pajā, tasmā hi vītarāgesu, dinnaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.
disvāna āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, ān'āpānassatiṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. ān'āpānassati, rāhula, bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā'ti.

51610.meaning1: even more fruitful; yielding better results (than)

examples.text: yo vā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ antamaso gadduhanamattam'pi mettacittaṃ bhāveyya… idaṃ tato mahapphalataraṃ.

51611.meaning2: fact of having great fruit; fact of yielding good results

51613.meaning2: having a great power or strong force
51613.commentary: (DNa) puttā'pi tassa bahavo, indanāmā mahabbalā'ti tassa dhataraṭṭhassa bahavo mahabbalā puttā, te sabbe sakkassa devarañño nāmadhārakā.

examples.text: puttā'pi tassa bahavo, indanāmā mahabbalā, iddhimanto jutimanto, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, modamānā abhikkāmuṃ, bhikkhūnaṃ samitiṃ vanaṃ.
pitussa vacanaṃ sutvā, devavaṇṇī pabhāvatī, sirasā aggahī pāde, kusarājaṃ mahabbalaṃ.

51615.meaning1: great fear; great danger; enormous risk

examples.text: tassa te n'atthi bhītattaṃ, bhiyyo vaṇṇo pasīdati, kasmā na paridevesi, evarūpe mahabbhaye.
taṇhā janeti purisaṃ, cittam'assa vidhāvati, satto saṃsāram'āpādi, dukkham'assa mahabbhayan'ti.

51616.meaning1: very dangerous; frightfully fearful; extremely perilous

examples.text: arūpa dūraṅ'gama ekacāri, na te karissaṃ vacanaṃ idāni'haṃ, dukkhā hi kāmā kaṭukā mahabbhayā, nibbānam'ev'ābhimano carissaṃ.

51617.meaning1: I self-generation; I (having seen that) I am self-begotten
51617.commentary: (THa) taṃ viditvā mahamattasambhavan'ti taṃ yathāvuttaṃ saṅkhatasabhāvaṃ attasambhavaṃ attani sambhūtaṃ attāyattaṃ issar'ādi-vasena aparāyattaṃ pariññ'ābhisamayavasena ahaṃ viditvā tappaṭipakkhabhūtaṃ

examples.text: sambhavā suviditā asārakā, saṅkhatā pacalitā sad'eritā, taṃ viditvā m'aham'attasambhavaṃ, santim'eva satimā samajjhagan'ti.

51618.commentary: (MNa) yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā'ti ettha pitu pitā pitāmaho, pitāmahassa yugaṃ pitāmahayugaṃ. yugan'ti āyuppamāṇaṃ vuccati. abhilāpamattam'eva c'etaṃ, atthato pana pitāmaho'va pitāmahayugaṃ. tato uddhaṃ sabbe'pi pubbapurisā pitāmahaggahaṇen'eva gahitā. evaṃ yāva sattamo puriso, tāva saṃsuddhagahaṇiko. atha vā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādenā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: jānanti pana bhonto, yā janikāmātu mātā yāva sattamā mātumātāmahayugā brāhmaṇaṃ'y'eva agamāsi, no abrāhmaṇan'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho.
bhavañ'hi caṅkī ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
aham'asmi, bhante, jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto āturakāyo abhikkhaṇ'ātaṅko.
yato ca kho ayaṃ bhavaṃ puriso jiṇṇo hoti vuddho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto, āsītiko vā nāvutiko vā vassasatiko vā jātiyā, atha tamhā paññāveyyattiyā, parihāyatī'ti.
ettha dāni, māluṅkyaputta, kiṃ dahare bhikkhū vakkhāma yatra hi nāma tvaṃ, bhikkhu, jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto saṃkhittena ovādaṃ yācasī'ti.
eta'r'ahi jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto āsītiko me vayo vattati. app'ekad'āhaṃ, bho raṭṭhapāla, idha pādaṃ karissāmī'ti aññen'eva pādaṃ karomī'ti.

51621.synonym: oḷāra, bahu, mahatī, mahanta, mahantī, mahalla, mahallikā, mahā

examples.text: tassā hi nāma, āvuso, bāhirāya pathavīdhātuyā tāva mahallikāya aniccatā paññāyissati, khayadhammatā paññāyissati, vayadhammatā paññāyissati, vipariṇāmadhammatā paññāyissati.
mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena yāva dvārakosā aggaḷaṭṭhapanāya ālokasandhiparikammāya dvatticchadanassa pariyāyaṃ appaharite ṭhitena adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ

sabbasaṃhārako n'atthi, suddhaṃ kaṅgu pavāyati, alikaṃ bhāyatiyaṃ dhuttī, saccam'āha mahallikā'ti.

51629.commentary: (ANa) na mah'assādan'ti yam'pi'ssa phalaṃ hoti, tassa assādo na mahā hoti mand'assādaṃ na madhuraṃ.

examples.text: aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgate, bhikkhave, khette bījaṃ vuttaṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti na mah'assādaṃ na phātiseyyaṃ. kathaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgate?

51630.meaning1: breathing heavily; panting loudly; gasping for breath
51630.commentary: (SNa) mah'assāsī'ti tassa gacchato balavā bhattaparīḷāho udapādi, tasmā mahantehi assāsehi assasati, gattato'pi'ssa sedabindūni muccanti, tam'enaṃ ubhosu passesu ṭhatvā yamakatālavaṇṭehi bījanti, buddhagāravena pana nipajjituṃ na ussahatī'ti idaṃ sandhāya mah'assāsī'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ bhuttāviṃ mah'assāsiṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

51631.grammar: adj, masc nom sg of mahanta
51631.meaning1: great; large; powerful; grand; vast; extensive
51631.synonym: uḷāra, oḷāra, bahu, bhūri, mahatī, mahanta, mahantī, mahalla, mahallaka, mahallikā, vipula

examples.text: laddhā hi so upādānaṃ, mahā hutvāna pāvako, so āsajja ḍahe bālaṃ, naraṃ nāriñ'ca ekadā.
taṃ kissa hetu? asu hi bhante gaṅgāya nadiyā mahā udakakkhandho so amunā loṇaphalena loṇo na assa apeyyo'ti.

51632.grammar: adj, in comps, masc nom sg of mahanta
51632.meaning1: great; powerful; mighty; eminent; distinguished; noble
51632.synonym: ariya, ugga, ucca, pavara, balasampanna, bhusa, mahatī, mahanta, mahantī

examples.text: ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettika-sambhavo odanakummāsa-upacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyath'idaṃ gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī, tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, mahāsamuddo'tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti

51633.meaning1: enormous out of season rain shower; massive unseasonal downpour

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse ūhataṃ rajojallaṃ, tam'enaṃ mahā-akālamegho ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, udāyi, yo vā ratt'andhakāratimisāya telappadīpo, yo vā ratt'andhakāra-timisāyaa mahāaggikkhandho, imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ katamo vaṇṇo abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā'ti?
hoti so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ mahāaggiḍāho vuṭṭhāti. mahāaggiḍāhe kho pana, bhikkhave, vuṭṭhite tena gāmā'pi ḍayhanti nigamā'pi ḍayhanti nagarā'pi ḍayhanti.
seyyathā'pi nāma mahāariṭṭhako maṇi, evam'assa sīsaṃ hoti. seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ rūpiyaṃ, evam'assa dantā honti.

51641.meaning1: massive body of water; great mass of water

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, mahāsamudde na sukaraṃ udakassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ, ettakāni udak'āḷhakānī'ti vā ettakāni udak'āḷhakasatānī'ti vā ettakāni udak'āḷhakasahassānī'ti vā ettakāni udak'āḷhakasatasahassānī'ti vā'ti. atha kho asaṅkhyeyyo appameyyo mahāudakakkhandho tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.

51642.meaning1: great sea; great ocean; great body of water

examples.text: tassa evam'assa, ayaṃ kho mahāudak'aṇṇavo, orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ, pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ, n'atthi ca nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā apārā pāraṃ gamanāya.
n'eso, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye samuddo. mahā eso, bhikkhave, udakarāsi mahāudak'aṇṇavo.

51643.meaning1: great flood; massive torrent of water

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti so samayo yaṃ mahāmegho vuṭṭhāti. mahāmeghe kho pana, bhikkhave, vuṭṭhite mahāudakavāhako sañjāyati. mahāudakavāhake kho pana, bhikkhave, sañjāyante tena gāmā'pi vuyhanti nigamā'pi vuyhanti nagarā'pi vuyhanti.

51645.meaning1: great female disciple; eminent female devotee

examples.text: kiñci bahiddhā cintanaṃ nāma na cintesi. mahā-upāsikā'pi dibbena cakkhunā olokentī theraṃ disvā, idāni ovādadāyakaṃ ācariyaṃ labhitvā pun'āgato mama putto'ti attano ñāṇen'eva paricchinditvā tassa sappāy'āhāraṃ paṭiyādetvā adāsi.

51648.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in explaining a brief instruction in detail
51648.commentary: (AN 1.197) etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajantānaṃ yadidaṃ mahākaccāno'ti

examples.text: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ avidūre nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya kāyagatāya satiyā ajjhattaṃ parimukhaṃ sūpaṭṭhitāya.

ayaṃ kho āyasmā mahākaccāno satthu c'eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ. pahoti c'āyasmā mahākaccāno imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.

satta devā, satta mānusā, satta pesācā, satta sarā, satta pavuṭā, satta papātā, satta papātasatāni, satta supinā, satta supinasatāni, cullāsīti mahākappino satasahassāni, yāni bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti.

51665.meaning1: detailed analysis of action; great classification of deeds

examples.text: api ca, ānanda, ke ca aññatitthiyā paribbājakā bālā abyattā ke ca tathāgatassa mahākammavibhaṅgaṃ jānissanti? sace tumhe, ānanda, suṇeyyātha tathāgatassa mahākammavibhaṅgaṃ vibhajantassā'ti.

51666.meaningLit: longer discourse on the analysis of action

51667.commentary: (NIDD2a) mahākaruṇāsamāpattiyā ñāṇan'ti ettha paradukkhe sati sādhūnaṃ hadayakampanaṃ karotī'ti karuṇā, kināti vā paradukkhaṃ hiṃsati vināsetī'ti karuṇā, kirīyati vā dukkhitesu pharaṇavasena pasārīyatīti karuṇā, pharaṇakammavasena kammaguṇavasena ca mahatī karuṇā mahākaruṇā, samāpajjanti etaṃ mahākāruṇikā'ti samāpatti, mahākaruṇā ca sā samāpatti cā'ti mahākaruṇāsamāpatti, tassaṃ mahākaruṇāsamāpattiyaṃ. taṃ sampayuttaṃ vā ñāṇaṃ.

examples.text: indriyaparopariyatta-ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, sattānaṃ āsay'ānusaya-ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, yamakapāṭihīre ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, mahākaruṇāsamāpattiyā ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, sabbaññutañāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ…

atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yen'āyasmā mahākassapo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ etadavoca, āyām'āvuso, kassapa, yen'āyasmā sāriputto ten'upasaṅkamissāma dhammassavanāyā'ti.

51670.meaning1: the story of the elder Mahākassapa
51670.meaning2: the story of the elder Mahākassapa

51672.meaning2: having a fat or big body

examples.text: sukhumālā mahākāyā, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, brāhmaṇā sehi dhammehi, kicc'ākiccesu ussukā, yāva loke avattiṃsu, sukham'edhitth'ayaṃ pajā.

51673.commentary: (THa) pañcannam'pi mārānaṃ vijayato jino, hīn'ādivibhāgabhinne sabbasmiṃ sattanikāye adhimuttavuttitāya mahatiyā karuṇāya samannāgatattā mahākāruṇiko

examples.text: sabbaññū sabbadassāvī, jino ācariyo mama, mahākāruṇiko satthā, sabbalokatikicchako.
mahāmatī mahāvīro, mahājhāyī mahābalo, mahākāruṇiko nātho, mahātamapanūdano.

51675.meaning1: with many duties; with numerous obligations

examples.text: brāhmaṇā, bho gotama, evam'āhaṃsu, mah'aṭṭham'idaṃ mahākiccaṃ mah'ādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ ghar'āvāsakammaṭṭhānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti, app'aṭṭham'idaṃ appakiccaṃ app'ādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ pabbajjā kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaphalaṃ hotī'ti. idha bhavaṃ gotamo kim'āhā'ti.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññatarasmiṃ udakarahade mahākummakulaṃ ciranivāsi ahosi. atha kho, bhikkhave, aññataro kummo aññataraṃ kummaṃ etadavoca, mā kho tvaṃ, tāta kumma, etaṃ padesaṃ agamāsī'ti.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso asappuriso mahākulā pabbajito hoti. so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi mahākulā pabbajito, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na mahākulā pabbajitā'ti.

51679.meaning1: fact of belonging to a prominent family

examples.text: ahaṃ kho'mhi mahākulā pabbajito, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na mahākulā pabbajitā'ti. so tāya mahākulīnatāya attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.

51680.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in analytical understanding
51680.notes: Theragāthā verse 2 (TH1.2, TH2) is attributed to him.

examples.text: āyasmatā ca sāriputtena āyasmatā ca mahāmoggallānena āyasmatā ca mahākassapena āyasmatā ca mahākaccāyanena āyasmatā ca mahākoṭṭhikena āyasmatā ca mahākappinena
ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.

51683.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in analytical understanding
51683.commentary: (MNa) mahākoṭṭhiko'ti tassa therassa nāmaṃ. (MNa) na hi sakkā yāya vā tāya vā appamattikāya paññāya samannāgatena bhikkhunā catupaṭisambhidāpabhedassa matthakaṃ pāpuṇituṃ. mahāpaññena pana sakkā'ti mahāpaññatāya mahākoṭṭhitatthero adhigamaparipucchāsavanapubbayogānaṃ vasena anantanay'ussadaṃ paṭisambhidāpabhedaṃ patto. ten'eva naṃ bhagavā etadagge ṭhapesi, etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisambhidāpattānaṃ yadidaṃ mahākoṭṭhito'ti (a. ni. 1.218).
51683.notes: Theragāthā verse 2 (TH1.2, TH2) is attributed to him.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisambhidāpattānaṃ yadidaṃ mahākoṭṭhito'ti.

tasmiṃ y'eva gaṅgākūle ṭhitā bandhumatī nāma gaṇikā assosi raññā kira evaṃ vuttaṃ sakkā nu kho imaṃ mahāgaṅgaṃ paṭisotaṃ sandāpetun'ti, sā evam'āha ahañ'hi nagare pāṭaliputte gaṇikā rūp'ūpajīvinī antimajīvikā, mama tāva rājā saccakiriyaṃ passatū'ti.

aparam'pi, bhante, upamaṃ karothā'ti. yathā, mahārāja, mahāgaṅgāya oghapuṇṇāya sūcipāsaṃ sammukhaṃ kareyya, sūcipāsena gata-udakaṃ appaṃ, sesaṃ bahu, evam'eva mayā kathitaguṇā appā, avasesā bahū'ti. aparam'pi, bhante, upamaṃ karothā'ti.
mahāgini pajjalito, anāhāro'pasammati, aṅgāresu ca santesu, nibbuto'ti pavuccati.

51688.meaning1: name of a village in Sri Lanka

examples.text: tatr'imāni vatthūni, senagirivāsī tissatthero kira mahāgirigāmaṃ upanissāya viharati.

51689.meaning1: massive pile of dung; large heap of excrement

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, mīḷhakā gūth'ādī gūthapūrā puṇṇā gūthassa. purato c'assa mahāgūthapuñjo. sā tena aññā mīḷhakā atimaññeyya, aham'hi gūth'ādī gūthapūrā puṇṇā gūthassa, purato ca my'āyaṃ mahāgūthapuñjo'ti.

51690.commentary: (NIDD1) eso tassa mahāgedho mahāvanaṃ mahāgahanaṃ mahākantāro mahāvisamo mahākuṭilo mahāpaṅko mahāpalipo mahāpalibodho mahābandhanaṃ, yadidaṃ sampajānamusāvādo'ti

examples.text: atha satthāni kurute, paravādehi codito, esa khv'assa mahāgedho, mosavajjaṃ pagāhati.
atha kho bho mahāgovindo brāhmaṇo tassa satt'āhassa accayena kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji

51698.commentary: (MNa) mahācattārīsako'ti mahāvipākadānena mahantānaṃ kusalapakkhikānañ'c'eva akusalapakkhikānañ'ca cattārīsāya dhammānaṃ pakāsitattā mahācattārīsako'ti.

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, vīsati kusalapakkhā, vīsati akusalapakkhā, mahācattārīsako dhammapariyāyo pavattito appaṭivattiyo samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
